summary.question: 上个月客单价和笔单价

payload.question: 上个月客单价和笔单价

metrics.label: 客单价
metrics.description: GMV ÷ 下单用户数（按人计算）。按订单计算的是“笔单价”。

notes: 数据范围：上海徐汇店（行级权限由系统强制执行，结果只包含你有权限的数据）。

queries.title: 客单价、笔单价
queries.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0), 2) AS aov,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
LIMIT 1000

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0), 2) AS aov,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE
    store_id IN ('S01')
) AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
LIMIT 1000
